name: glisse
description: Build Liquid Glass / iOS 26-style glass UI on the web with the glisse React components.

interface.shortDescription: Liquid Glass React UI for the web
interface.longDescription: Teaches coding agents how to install and use glisse: faithful iOS 26 Liquid Glass components (Glass, Button, Switch, Slider, TabBar, SegmentedControl, Menu, Input, SearchField), refraction fallbacks, theming, and common pitfalls.
defaultPrompt: Add a glisse Switch and filled Button to this settings panel.
Build an iOS 26-style TabBar with glisse over a marked backdrop.
Create a Liquid Glass Menu and SegmentedControl with glisse.
